metadata.name: CardholderRegistration
metadata.description: Use this API to register user by capturing PII data , Pin information, Security question's answers and password.

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked Example: 1.3 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of sender Example:  10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source from where API Call is initiated. CoreCard have multiple value of source for internal system (CoreMoney, SelfService, IVR, MobileSelfService) For external system expected source will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller Id of source from where API is initiated. It is End User phone number. Example: 7204454214 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called Id of destination for which API is initiated. It is Corecard IVR number. Example: 7314145404 Condition - applicable in Case of IVR Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ANI
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: DNS
request_fields.description: Reserved for future use Allowable Values: 0

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Flag to retrieve error message in specific language Example: 'en' for English Allowable Values: 2

request_fields.name: RequestDate
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM-DD-YYYYTHH:MM:SS Example:- 11-12-2021T13:05:10 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Clear Card Number of the cardholder Valid values: 0-9 Example: 123456******0001 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: ProxyNumber
request_fields.description: Proxy Number of the cardholder Valid values:0-9 Example:1005 Condition: At least one of Card Number/Proxy Number is required. Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: NewUserID
request_fields.description: New User ID Valid Values as A-Z, 0-9. Example: NewUser123 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: AddressLine1
request_fields.description: Address Line 1 of the Cardholder Valid values : A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 15 Penang Street Point Condition: Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: AddressLine2
request_fields.description: Address Line 2 of the Cardholder Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: 1 mecca way Condition: Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: Country
request_fields.description: This tag indicates the country of the cardholder. It should be 2 character code. Valid values :A-Z, a-z Example: US Appendix Section: Country Code Values Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: City
request_fields.description: Cardholder's City of residence Valid values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 Example: Norcross Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: PostalCode
request_fields.description: Cardholder Postal Code of Residence Valid Values:A-Z,a-z,0-9 Example: 30093 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: State
request_fields.description: Cardholder State of residence Valid values are A-Z, a-z Example: GA Please refer Appendix Section : State Codes(US) Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: EmailAddress
request_fields.description: E Mail Address of Cardholder Valid Values: A-Z, a-z, 0-9 @ . Example: ansh @gmail.com Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: CurrentPassword
request_fields.description: Current Password of Cardholder. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z,0-9, Special characters. Example: Test123! Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: NewPassword
request_fields.description: New Password of Cardholder. Valid Values: A-Z, a-z,0-9, Special characters. Example: Test123! Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: CurrentPIN
request_fields.description: Four Digit Current PIN Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1346 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: NewPIN
request_fields.description: Four Digit New PIN of the card Valid Values: 0-9 Example:1346 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: SSNLast4Digits
request_fields.description: Last 4 digits of Social Security Number of a Cardholder Valid values :0-9 Example: 6789 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: DateOfBirth
request_fields.description: Date of Birth of cardholder Format: MM/DD/YYYY Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 03/26/1986 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CVCorCVV
request_fields.description: CVV of the card Example : 546 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 3

request_fields.name: CardExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration Date of the card. Valid Values: 0-9 DateFormat : MMYY Example : 0925 Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: ReadDisclosure
request_fields.description: Disclosure value indicating the user has read terms and conditions. Allowable Values: 1

request_fields.name: SACValue
request_fields.description: Used to hold SAC Value passed by user in input. Condition : Mandatory if required for user registration else Optional Allowable Values: 14

request_fields.name: ID
request_fields.description: ID of question asked Allowable Values: 32

request_fields.name: Question
request_fields.description: Security question which will be asked during forgot pin or forgot password Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: Answer
request_fields.description: Answer of the security question Allowable Values: 100

response_fields.name: Message
response_fields.description: Returns Error Message in case of Error.

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: Returns result of API processing. If any error is found then value will be 'false' else 'true'.

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Returns Error Code in case of Error.

response_fields.name: ResponseData
response_fields.description: This is group of below data elements.

children.name: IsSecurityQuestionAsked
children.description: Security questions should be asked or not to the user. Valid values : Yes , No
